names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Μαΐου, «Οσία Έλενα του Ντιβέεβο», with the rank word left off. The life page gives her full name in the world: «Η Έλενα Βασίλιεβνα Μαντούροβα».

The heading of the calendar’s name link 14263, «Елена (Мантурова) Дивеевская, прмц.», with the rank abbreviation left off. The parenthesis is the calendar’s own and holds her family name; the day’s own line gives «Елены Дивеевской», without it. `fk.mjs` returned NONE for «дивеевская елена мантурова» before the write. THE BARE «Елена» WAS NOT STORED: it is the fold key this branch wrote on 05-21 over `helen-martyr-1943` and `helen-the-empress`, and this is the third folder in the branch whose bare Helen was withheld.

death.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Οσια Ελενα Του Ντιβεεβο (; - 1832)», and the body gives the day with the year: «Εκοιμήθη εν Κυρίω στις 28 Μαΐου 1832 μ.Χ.» It gives no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 мая ст. ст. — «Прп. Елены Дивеевской (1832).»

attestations.note: The identification is exact: the line gives Diveyevo, which is this folder’s display name, and the year 1832 its `dates` already hold, and its Greek row keeps her on the same Julian day. `dates` is unchanged. THE CALENDAR GIVES HER NO LIFE PAGE: her line carries a link to her name, 14263, and none to a reading. What the name link gives that the day line does not is her surname, «Елена (Мантурова) Дивеевская, прмц.»; the day page prints no hymn under her name. THE FORM STORED IS NOT A BARE FORENAME, and that is why it could be stored at all: it is the name link's whole string less the rank, «Елена (Мантурова) Дивеевская», which is three words and not a bare forename, so it does NOT touch the fold key «елена» this branch wrote on 05-21. THE NAME LINK'S RANK ABBREVIATION CONTRADICTS THE DAY LINE'S and neither was written into `types`: the line says «Прп.», venerable, which this folder already holds, and the name page says «прмц.», venerable-martyr, which would make her a martyr of 1832 — a thing nothing else on either page supports. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Μαΐου — «Οσία Έλενα του Ντιβέεβο»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and records where her relics are: «Τα Ιερά Λείψανα της Οσίας Έλενας του Ντιβέεβο βρίσκονται στη Μονή Ντιβίγιεβο Ρωσίας». It marks Seraphim of Sarov as kept on 2 January and the nun Alexandra on 13 June. It prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
